create_model_card_data: create a ModelCardData object with language, license, and pipeline_tag for a Hugging Face model card
create_eval_result: create an EvalResult object with task_type, dataset_type, dataset_name, metric_type, and metric_value for evaluation metrics
convert_eval_results_to_model_index: convert a list of EvalResult objects into a model-index dict compatible with Hugging Face Hub
parse_model_index_to_eval_results: parse a model-index list from a README into EvalResult objects and a model name
create_dataset_card_data: create a DatasetCardData object with language, license, and task_categories for a Hugging Face dataset card
